# KaTeX 0.16.22

Vendored from the `katex@0.16.22` npm package, https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX.
The original MIT license is included as `LICENSE`.

`katex.min.js` is used only by `scripts/render-math.cjs` during site generation.
The browser loads the local CSS and font files, with no external CDN requests.
Rendered equations include both HTML and MathML.
